## Plato on responsibility

Plato (c. 428/427–348/347 BCE) approaches responsibility within Platonism. Plato’s theory of Forms holds that changing sensibles participate in eternal, intelligible paradigms—Justice, Beauty, Equality—crowned by the Form of the Good. Knowledge differs from mere opinion by grasping these stable realities through dialectic and recollection. On this page, the archive isolates English passages where that project meets responsibility most directly—useful for searches such as “plato quotes on responsibility.”
